description: Check a planned or new feature for legal risks. Call this whenever the user plans or builds a feature for a product used in Sri Lanka, or made by a Sri Lankan company or person, even if they didn't ask about law. If the user hasn't said where the users or company are, ask them first; never guess the country. Send country codes and facts from get_fact_questions only (no idea text, no code). Returns warnings with severity (Must / Should / Check with a lawyer), the law and section, what to do, and the areas NOT covered.

company_in.description: ISO country code where the company (or maker) is, e.g. 'LK'
company_in.title: Company In

done.description: rule_id values of warnings the user says are already handled. Only when the user says so; they are listed as 'done', not verified.
done.title: Done

facts.description: List of the facts that are true, from get_fact_questions
facts.title: Facts

processing_in.description: ISO country codes where data is stored or processed
processing_in.title: Processing In

users_in.description: ISO country codes where users are, as the user said, e.g. ['LK']
users_in.title: Users In

name: check_legal_risks
